# Chicken meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: ChickenMeat | Source: Chicken, ,, Hen | Usage: Cooking station, ,, Food preparation table | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Chicken meat is a food source dropped by Hens and Chickens when they are killed, such as with a Butcher knife or after enabling PVP.
When placed on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station, Chicken meat can be turned into Cooked chicken meat, or Coal if left to burn.

## Availability

• Creature: Chicken | 0 Star: 25%

• Creature: Hen | 0 Star: 1

### Crafting

• Cooked chicken meat Health: +60 Stamina: +20 Healing: +5hp/tick Effects Duration: 20 minutes
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long
• Honey glazed chicken (from Uncooked honey glazed chicken)
Cooked chicken meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Chicken meat as ingredient.

Categorias: Materials, Food
